description: This file defines an interface 'TokenStream' for managing a stream of tokens in a parser. It includes method signatures for accessing tokens, retrieving token sources, and getting string representations of token sequences.

classes.name: TokenStream
classes.description: An interface for a stream of tokens used in parsing, providing methods for token access, source retrieval, and range-based string conversion.

methods.name: LT
methods.description: Returns the token at the current position plus offset k, supporting lookahead and lookbehind.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the token at a specific absolute index.

methods.name: getTokenSource
methods.description: Returns the object that provides tokens for this stream.

methods.name: toStringBetween
methods.description: Returns the concatenated text of tokens between specified start and stop indices.

methods.name: toStringBetweenTokens
methods.description: Returns the string representation between two token objects, likely delegating to 'toStringBetween'.
